Status.note: The EIA-860M table for September 2026 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx) lists generators CTG1 and STG1 as operating. The TVA plant page (https://www.tva.com/energy/our-power-system/natural-gas/magnolia-combined-cycle-plant) describes the plant as in service. I found no retirement, mothballing or planned retirement notice.

Capacity (MW).note: The EIA-860M table for September 2026 lists CTG1 at 178.5 MW and STG1 at 156.0 MW. Together that is 334.5 MW, which rounds to the 335 MW GEM already shows. Plant 55451, unit code MCC1, status operating.

units.notes: Nothing has changed for this unit. The EIA table shows it operating with no planned retirement date, and I found no news of a retirement or sale.
